Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/13] The descriptive statistics, bivariate correlations, and internal consistency reliabilities of the scales are shown in Table 1. Correlations indicated that entity theory of intelligence was positively correlated with negative affect. There was also a marginally significant negative relationship between entity theory and life satisfaction. However, entity theory of intelligence was not significantly associated with positive affect. [/page/3/Text/14] Results showed that the ICCs for all the variables (entity theory ICC = .01; life satisfaction ICC = .01; positive affect ICC = .00, negative affect ICC = .01) were extremely small.
